passive.name: Reign of Anger
passive.description: Renekton's attacks generate Fury, increased when he is low on life. This Fury can empower his abilities with bonus effects.

primaryAbilities.name: Cull the Meek
primaryAbilities.description: Renekton swings his blade, dealing moderate physical damage to all targets around him, and heals for a small portion of the damage dealt. If he has more than 50 Fury, his damage and heal are increased.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Renekton swings his blade, dealing {{ basicdamage }} physical damage and restoring {{ nonchamphealing }} Health per non-champion and {{ champhealing }} per champion hit. He also generates {{ minionfurygain }} Fury per non-champion and {{ championfurygain }} Fury per champion.

Fury Bonus: Damage is increased to {{ empdamage }} physical damage and healing is increased to {{ empnonchamphealing }} Health against non-champions and {{ empchamphealing }} Health against champions. Does not generate any Fury.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Ruthless Predator
primaryAbilities.description: Renekton slashes his target twice, dealing moderate physical damage and stuns them for 0.75 seconds. If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target, dealing high physical damage, and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Renekton's next Attack strikes twice, Stunning for {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing a total of {{ basictotaldamage }} physical damage. Hitting a champion generates an additional {{ bonusfuryvschamps }} Fury.

Fury Bonus: Renekton Attacks 3 times instead, destroying Shields before dealing {{ emptotaldamage }} physical damage and Stunning for {{ enragedstunduration }} seconds. Does not generate any Fury.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Slice and Dice
primaryAbilities.description: Renekton dashes, dealing damage to units along the way. Empowered, Renekton deals bonus damage and reduces the Armor of units hit.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Renekton dashes, dealing {{ basicdamage }} physical damage. He generates {{ minionragegeneration }} Fury per non-champion and {{ championragegeneration }} Fury per champion hit. Hitting at least one enemy allows Renekton to Recast this Ability once for {{ dicetimer }} seconds.

Fury Bonus: The Recast dash deals {{ empdamage }} physical damage instead and removes {{ enragedarmorshred }}% Armor for {{ shredtimer }} seconds. Does not generate Fury.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Dominus
primaryAbilities.description: Renekton transforms into the Tyrant form, gaining bonus Health and dealing damage to enemies around him. While in this form, Renekton gains Fury periodically.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Renekton surrounds himself with dark energies for {{ buffduration }} seconds, gaining <healing>{{ healthgain }} max Health</healing> and <keywordMajor>{{ furyoncast }} Fury</keywordMajor>. While active, he deals <magicDamage>{{ totaldamagepersecond }} magic damage</magicDamage> and gains <keywordMajor>{{ furypersecond }} Fury</keywordMajor> per second.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Renekton gains [5] Fury per Attack. While above [50] Fury, his next Ability spends it to become empowered. Fury decays while out of combat.

While below [50]% Health, Renekton gains [50]% increased Fury.
